about.description: SMIC is a single-stock perpetual listed on Bitget, tracking Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corp., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 5x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
